create_layer_subclass: create a subclass of Layer that implements __call__ to define a neural network layer
call_layer_with_side_inputs: call a Layer instance with a positional argument and keyword side inputs like attention masks
bind_variables_to_layer: bind a collection of variables to a Layer instance using bind_variables to insert parameter values
run_stateless_layer_call: run a Layer with stateless_call to get results and updated variable values without mutating state
repr_layer_with_treescope: repr a Layer instance using __treescope_repr__ for structured debugging output
